[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Nyran''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who commanded the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Nullifier]]''. Nyran was given strict orders by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to restrict landings on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] during the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] of [[Rivoche Tarkin]] and [[Vastin Caglio]].<ref name="SF" />
